014 爆炸事件和野心
第二天，关雨早早的起来，早上没课他直接离开宿舍，最后租了自行车踩到金沙滩，找了一个地方坐下，拿出最新型的手机开始看起新闻
张警成功逃脱，不过警局却没有声张，显然消息被封锁了。
毕竟刚刚开记者招待会发表逮捕的消息，接着就被犯人逃跑，警局的威信和形象绝对会遭受打击。
“不知道佐汉和张警现在在什么地方，恐怕已经离开燕海市了吧。”关雨心里嘀咕道。
这段时间他也不准备继续杀外国人，最好能够完成一些基础的任务，提升一下自身的实力。
例如装备的提升，还有就是技能，不过目前为止他都不清楚怎么升级。
一个游戏，怎么可能没用级别？
他可以肯定这个游戏是有所谓的级别，不过怎么升级他就不清楚了。
还有就是职业问题，他现在的职业是大学生，至于副职网管在他辞职的时候就消失了。
关雨可以肯定可以转职，但怎么转职他却十分蛋疼。
按照他的思路，转职的话最好是召唤师或者刺客，他觉得最理想的就是正职为召唤师，副职则是刺客。
召唤师可以召唤大量的召唤兽，而刺客可以隐身，如此一来生存能力绝对提高很多。
不过现在有没有这两个职业还难说呢。
毕竟系统刚刚开放，很多东西都还在摸索阶段，毕竟这是真实的游戏，不是电脑上的虚拟游戏。
关雨骑空间都有，而且还有组队系统，这组队系统、例如随即分配战利品，而且还有限制队员是否可以随意离队的选项，还有组队的时间选项，例如你选择和一个人组队，可以选择组队一小时，也可以选择组队几十年，如果选项中有不许离队的选项，那么必须几十年才能够解散队伍。
关雨却看出来了，这个组队系统必须极为谨慎使用，不然极为危险，例如队长分配这一条，如果你和别人组队忽略的话，很可能你一无所得！
当然，到时候组队恐怕会写的很清楚，不会存在被算计的可能，系统不可能偏颇任何一个玩家。
还有就是拍卖系统，不过要拍卖东西需要扣除最后所得10%作为佣金，当然了，现在只有两个完成内测任务的玩家，所以拍卖系统现在还什么都没有。
大致上了解了系统，关雨的看了两页，要知道商城可是足足有数百页。

继续看下去，关雨就发现，就连食物都可以再商城买到，不过特别的昂贵，一只烤鸡居然卖10金币！
关雨估计这是末世之后的价格，到时候食物短缺的话，还真有人可能成为冤大头去买来充饥。
不过他已经准备好储藏食物，毕竟他已经扩充了背包，足够他放更多的食物。
此时他还有900金，他已经想好如果封无没有其他的想法，一个星期后他会兑换一张激活码给封无。
而且晚上的时候，那托妮就会带一百万过来给他，关雨知道这已经算是开始交易，毕竟一百万也不少，如果封无有心准备，这一百万完全可以在这个月内换成大量物资。
关闭商城，就要重新找一个任务。
他这次想要找一个奖励技能的任务，毕竟早起的优势应该是体现在装备和技能之上，而职业的优势恐怕要以后才能够体现出来。
他都找不到转职的办法，其他人就更加不用想了。
找了一下，关雨最后发现一个任务不错，是C-级别，奖励则是F-级别的技能一个，当然还是随机的。
任务是集齐十颗一克拉以上的钻石，不过时限则是一小时。
这个任务最大的难度是在于时限，其余的问题倒不大，毕竟只要出名一点的珠宝店，大多数都存有一克拉以上的钻石。
关雨并没有立即接下这个任务，他需要详细的了解过后才会接，争取一个小时以内完成任务，因为任务失败的惩罚是扣除10寿命！
虽然关雨的寿命还有不少，但也经不起这样的扣法，所以他不允许自己出现失败。
关雨想了一下，拿出手机拨通封无的手机号，一会儿手机就传来封无的声音：“有什么事？”
“一个任务，一克拉的钻石，需要十枚，能够集齐吗？”关雨问道。
封无现在是合作伙伴，关雨自然不会漏掉他，如果封无可以搞定的话，他也不一定要自己亲自去完成。
片刻后，封无回答道：“可以。”
“很好，既然这样，我也答应你，你再辅助我完成一个任务，我给你激活码！”关雨淡淡的说道，他不是那种忘恩负义之人，既然封无已经付出不少，他也不会小气，虽然500金币真不少。
另一头封无顿时眼睛一亮，他心里暗道，零果然有激活码！
人说谎其实都有迹可循，封无之前就感觉关雨其实是说谎，只不过他并没有证据，只能暂且相信。

不过现在封无看来，自己是赌对了！
“没问题！”封无立即回答道，钱财不过身外之物，他来天朝的时候其实就带来了好几个助手和保镖，毕竟他的敌人不少，此时他立即安排人员开始准备收购钻石。
封无很有钱，不过在他知道末世即将来临的时候就开始抛售自己以往投资的股票，同时将不动产都转化为流动资金，开始购买各种物品，例如粮食、稀有金属等等，全都在他购买的行列之中。
同时他也让温媛帮他办理转户籍的手续，他要赶紧变成天朝阵营！
原因很简单，世界人口最多的国家就是天朝，如此庞大的人口基数就已经奠定了天朝将会成为最强大阵营的地位，阵营和阵营之间必定会有摩擦，最后爆发阵营与阵营之间的战争！
封无此时快速的思考着，未来的计划，唯一让他感到棘手的就是系统，他不知道系统未来的变化。
就像游戏，有的游戏必须靠团队合作才能够变得强大，独行者往往没有大作为，而有些游戏，却是实行个人英雄主义，一个人能够抵挡千军万马，一挥手就能够秒杀一片，他不知道系统是偏向于哪一边！
不过这些都不急，现在封无首要的任务就是成为玩家！
关雨挂了电话，随后继续看任务，任务可是出人意料的多，一个早上就这样过去了，下午他有课，不过他早就准备不去上课，直接取了单车准备找个地方吃饭。
但这时候一声巨响从远处传来，随即地面都微微震荡，关雨看向声源的方向，顿时看到黑烟慢慢的升上天空。
发生了什么事？
不等关雨思考，只见天空忽然闪光，只见一行字出现了：恭喜ID：10936玩家第三位完成内测任务，奖励力量：1，金币50，内测礼包一个！
关雨顿时凝重起来，难道这两者之间有所联系？
他立即踩着自行车向冒烟的方向飞驰而去，很快就赶到冒烟的地方，居然是一家百货超市。
关雨混在人群中，听了半天终于明白什么事，刚刚百货超市忽然发生大爆炸，不少顾客和服务员都遭了难。
拿出手机，关雨缓缓离开人群，拨通封无的电话，道：“刚刚家多美百货超市发生大爆炸，随后我就收到消息，ID为10936的玩家第三位完成内测任务，我觉得两者之间有关系。”
“你想的没错，而且我还知道凶手是谁。”封无说道。
此时他心里更为在意的是第三位的ID：10936，这个ID已经说明内测玩家的数量已经过万！
而目前完成任务的人却只有三个，完成率出乎意料的低，但却又在意料之中。
关雨听了封无的话，一愣随即问道：“第三人是谁？”

“哈根！”封无淡淡的说道。
关雨顿时怔住，如果是哈根的话，还真有可能炸掉整个百货，他有这样的能力，同样他也有这样的胆量！
“昨天晚上我就收到情报，哈根向一个军火贩子买了大量的炸弹，不过按照他买的炸弹数量，恐怕接下来他还会继续，我会尝试利用警方的力量，牵制住他，我们现在应该没有必要与他为敌吧？”封无说道。
关雨却忽然冷笑道：“不，我要杀了他！”
刚刚浏览任务，他就看到一个C-级别的任务，杀死一名其他阵营的正式玩家，奖励F+级别技能一个！
只要今晚两个任务完成的话，他就能够拥有一件E-级别的装备和一个F-级别的技能，对付哈根还是有一定把握，再加上封无和托妮的话，任务完成率很高！
关雨是一个谨小慎微的人，但这仅限于他执行的时候，要知道他的胆子可是很大！
决定很大胆，执行很谨慎，这就是关雨！
富贵险中求，关雨不相信简简单单就可以成为强大的玩家，以后末世来临，丧尸横行，肯定会有更加危险的任务，只有现在累积更多的资本，才能够从容应付将来的危机！
所以他决定拼一把，疯狂一把，杀死哈根！

014 Explosions and Ambition
The next day, Guan Yu got up early. He left the dormitory directly without classes in the morning. Finally, he rented a bicycle and rode to the golden beach. He found a place to sit down, took out the latest mobile phone and started watching the news.
Officer Zhang successfully escaped, but the police station did not make any announcement. Apparently the news was blocked.
After all, they had just held a press conference to announce the arrest, and then the prisoner escaped. The prestige and image of the police department would definitely take a hit.
"I don't know where Zuo Han and Police Zhang are now. I'm afraid they have left Yanhai City." Guan Yu muttered in his heart.
He is not planning to continue killing foreigners during this period. It is best to complete some basic tasks and improve his own strength.
For example, there are equipment upgrades and skills, but so far he doesn't know how to upgrade.
How can a game have no levels?
He was sure that this game had so-called levels, but he didn't know how to upgrade.
There is also the issue of career. His current occupation is that of a college student. As for the deputy network administrator, he disappeared when he resigned.
Guan Yu was sure he could change jobs, but how to change jobs was a pain in the ass for him.
According to his thinking, if he changes his profession, it is best to be a summoner or an assassin. He thinks that the most ideal one is to have a summoner as a main job and an assassin as a secondary job.
The summoner can summon a large number of summoned beasts, and the assassin can become invisible, which definitely improves the survivability.
But it’s hard to say whether these two professions exist now.
After all, the system has just been opened, and many things are still in the exploratory stage. After all, this is a real game, not a virtual game on the computer.
Guan Yuqi has space, and there is also a team system. This team system, for example, distributes loot immediately, and also has the option to limit whether players can leave the team at will, as well as the time option for team formation. For example, if you choose to team up with one person, you can choose to team up for one hour, or you can choose to team up for decades. If there is an option not to leave the team, it will take decades before the team can be disbanded.
Guan Yu saw that this teaming system must be used with extreme caution, otherwise it will be extremely dangerous. For example, if you ignore this rule assigned by the captain, if you team up with others and ignore it, you will probably get nothing!
Of course, when the time comes, the team formation will probably be written very clearly, there will be no possibility of being calculated, and the system cannot be biased against any player.
There is also the auction system, but if you want to auction something, you need to deduct 10% of the final income as commission. Of course, there are only two players who have completed the internal beta mission, so there is nothing in the auction system yet.
After roughly understanding the system, Guan Yu read two pages. You must know that the mall has hundreds of pages.
As he continued reading, Guan Yu discovered that even food could be bought in the mall, but it was extremely expensive. A roast chicken actually sold for 10 gold coins!
Guan Yu estimated that this was the price after the end of the world. If there was a shortage of food then, someone might really be taken advantage of and buy it to satisfy their hunger.
But he was ready to store food. After all, he had expanded his backpack enough to hold more food.
At this time, he still had 900 gold. He had already thought that if Feng Wu had no other ideas, he would redeem an activation code for Feng Wu after a week.
And at night, Toni would bring one million to him. Guan Yu knew that this was already the beginning of the transaction. After all, one million was not a lot. If Feng Wu was prepared, this million could be exchanged for a large amount of supplies within this month.
After closing the mall, you have to find a new task.
This time he wanted to find a mission that rewarded skills. After all, the advantage of getting up early should be reflected in equipment and skills, and the advantages of profession may only be reflected later.
He couldn't find a way to change jobs, and others didn't even have to think about it.
After searching for a while, Guan Yu finally found a good mission.It is C-level, and the reward is an F-level skill, which is of course still random.
The task is to collect ten diamonds over one carat, but the time limit is one hour.
The biggest difficulty of this task is the time limit. The other problems are not big. After all, most well-known jewelry stores have diamonds of more than one carat.
Guan Yu did not accept this task immediately. He needed to understand it in detail before accepting it. He tried to complete the task within an hour, because the penalty for failing the task was to deduct 10 life spans!
Although Guan Yu still has a lot of life left, he cannot withstand such a deduction, so he does not allow himself to fail.
Guan Yu thought for a moment, then took out his mobile phone and dialed Feng Wu's mobile number. After a while, Feng Wu's voice came from the mobile phone: "What's the matter?"
"A mission requires ten diamonds of one carat. Can you collect them all?" Guan Yu asked.
Feng Wu is now a partner, so Guan Yu will naturally not miss him. If Feng Wu can handle it, he doesn't necessarily have to do it himself.
After a moment, Feng Wu replied: "Okay."
"Very good, in that case, I promise you, if you help me complete another task, I will give you the activation code!" Guan Yu said lightly. He is not the kind of ungrateful person. Since Feng Wu has already paid a lot, he will not be stingy, although 500 gold coins is really a lot.
Feng Wu's eyes suddenly lit up on the other end, and he secretly thought to himself, Zero indeed has an activation code!
In fact, there are traces for people to lie. Feng Wu had felt that Guan Yu was actually lying before, but he had no evidence and could only believe it for the time being.
But now Feng Wu seems to have made the right bet!
"No problem!" Feng Wu replied immediately. Money is nothing more than personal possessions. When he came to China, he actually brought several assistants and bodyguards. After all, he had many enemies. At this time, he immediately arranged for people to start preparing to purchase diamonds.
Feng Wu was very rich, but when he knew that the end of the world was coming, he began to sell off the stocks he had invested in in the past. At the same time, he converted all real estate into working capital and began to purchase various items, such as grain, rare metals, etc., all of which were among his purchases.
At the same time, he also asked Wen Yuan to help him go through the procedures for transferring his household registration. He wanted to become the Chinese camp as soon as possible!
The reason is very simple. The most populous country in the world is the Chinese Empire. Such a huge population base has established the Chinese Empire as the most powerful camp. There will definitely be friction between the camps, and eventually a war will break out between the camps!
Feng Wu was thinking quickly about his future plans at this time. The only thing that troubled him was the system. He didn't know the future changes of the system.
Just like games, some games must rely on teamwork to become powerful. A lone player often does not achieve much, while some games implement personal heroism. One person can withstand thousands of troops and kill them with a wave of his hand. He does not know which side the system is biased towards!
But there's no rush, Feng Wu's first priority now is to become a player!
Guan Yu hung up the phone and continued to look at the tasks. There were surprisingly many tasks. The morning passed like this. He had classes in the afternoon, but he had already planned not to go to class. He directly picked up his bicycle and prepared to find a place to eat.
But at this time, a loud noise came from a distance, and then the ground shook slightly. Guan Yu looked towards the direction of the sound source, and immediately saw black smoke slowly rising into the sky.
What happened?
Before Guan Yu could think about it, the sky suddenly flashed, and a line of words appeared: Congratulations to the third player with ID: 10936 for completing the internal beta task. Reward power: 1, 50 gold coins, and a closed beta gift pack!
Guan Yu suddenly became serious. Is there any connection between the two?
He immediately pedaled his bicycle in the direction of the smoke, and soon arrived at the place where the smoke was coming. It turned out to be a department store.
Guan YuMixed in the crowd, after listening for a long time, I finally understood what happened. There was a big explosion in the department store just now, and many customers and waiters suffered.
Taking out his mobile phone, Guan Yu slowly left the crowd, dialed Feng Wu's number, and said: "There was a big explosion just now in our Duomei Department Store supermarket, and then I received news that the player with ID 10936 was the third to complete the internal beta mission. I think there is a relationship between the two."
"You are right, and I also know who the murderer is." Feng Wu said.
At this time, what he was more concerned about was the third ID: 10936. This ID already showed that the number of internal beta players had exceeded 10,000!
Currently, there are only three people who have completed the task. The completion rate is unexpectedly low, but it is expected.
After Guan Yu heard Feng Wu's words, he was stunned and then asked: "Who is the third person?"
"Hagen!" Feng Wu said calmly.
Guan Yu was stunned for a moment. If it was Hagen, it would really be possible to blow up the entire department store. He has such ability, and he also has such courage!
"I received intelligence last night that Hagen bought a large number of bombs from an arms dealer. However, according to the number of bombs he bought, I'm afraid he will continue to do so. I will try to use the power of the police to contain him. There should be no need for us to be enemies with him now, right?" Feng Wu said.
Guan Yu suddenly sneered: "No, I'm going to kill him!"
Just browsing the missions, he saw a C-level mission, killing an official player from another camp and rewarding him with an F+ level skill!
As long as the two tasks are completed tonight, he will be able to have an E-level equipment and an F-level skill. He will still have a certain degree of confidence in dealing with Hagen. Plus, with Feng Wu and Toni, the task completion rate is very high!
Guan Yu is a cautious person, but this is only when he is executing. You must know that he is very courageous!
The decision is bold and the execution is cautious, this is Guan Yu!
Wealth is gained through danger. Guan Yu does not believe that he can become a powerful player simply by doing it. In the future, when the apocalypse comes and zombies are rampant, there will definitely be more dangerous tasks. Only by accumulating more capital now can he be able to calmly deal with future crises!
So he decided to give it a go, go crazy, and kill Hagen!
